description: Add compact constructors jsonc.Object(keyvals...) and jsonc.Array(values...) with auto-type conversion. Add Get(key) and Delete(key) methods completing the mutation API: Get retrieves value node by key, Delete removes member + adjacent comma with fluent chaining. 3 new example tests. Refactor key comparison into memberKeyEquals helper, simplifying Set/Get/Delete. passing_tests 62→65.

Fix trailing-comment blank line in multi-line formatter. In fmtMember, skip trailing \n{indent} after a comment when it's the last meaningful child (hasMoreMemberContent check). The comment's own trailing \n from fmtComment is sufficient for spacing; the extra indent caused a blank line before closing brace. All 65 PBT and example tests pass, 0 lint issues.

Add Len() and Keys() methods on Node — completes mutation API symmetry after Get/Set/Delete. Len returns member count, Keys returns keys in document order. Both handle nil/non-Object gracefully. 2 new example tests, 0 lint issues.

Add Has(key) bool and Values() []*Node methods completing the mutation API trilogy. Has checks key existence (natural companion to Get/Set), Values returns value nodes in document order (companion to Keys). 2 new example tests, 0 lint issues.
